methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched/verified for Planning Center (planningcenter.com/pricing, /security), Tithe.ly (get.tithe.ly/pricing), Breeze ChMS (breezechms.com/pricing), ChurchTrac (churchtrac.com/pricing, churchtrac.com homepage), Subsplash (subsplash.com/pricing), Servant Keeper (servantkeeper.com/pricing), and Realm by ACS Technologies (acstechnologies.com/realm/plans, buy.acst.com/realm-inform). Faithlife ChMS excluded (discontinued 2023). Planning Center uses an interactive calculator with NO static per-tier prices shown on the official page; aggregators disagree on the lowest paid tier ($14 G2 vs $15 costbench), so the Services entry tier monthlyUsd is set to null (a null beats a guess) with the calculator range noted. Tithe.ly publishes PCI DSS Level 1 and GDPR compliance in its security guide but does NOT claim SOC 2; Planning Center explicitly claims SOC 2 Type 2 and PCI Level 1. ChurchTrac has a genuine free-forever plan (unlimited names, basic people management) distinct from its 30-day trial — corrected from the draft. Where a plan has no published price (Tithe.ly Enterprise, Subsplash One/Enterprise, Realm Connect/Multiply), monthlyUsd is null. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Planning Center
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from planningcenter.com/pricing (interactive calculator, no static per-tier amounts shown on official page). Lowest paid tier left null because aggregators disagree ($14 G2 vs $15 costbench) and the official page shows no fixed amount. SOC 2 Type 2 and PCI Level 1 confirmed at planningcenter.com/security and the company SOC 2 blog post.

plans.name: People (Free)
plans.notes: Free forever for unlimited users. Member database and reporting. All other modules (Services, Giving, Check-Ins, Groups, Calendar, Registrations) add on top of this free base. Church Center member app included free.

plans.name: Services (Entry, calculator)
plans.notes: Lowest paid Services tier. Official page is calculator-driven with no static amount; aggregators report a lowest tier around $14-$15/month scaling up roughly $14/$29/$59/$99/$149/$199 by team members. Set to null because the official page publishes no fixed price. Each module (Giving, Check-ins, Groups, Calendar, Registrations) priced separately by usage. Music Stand add-on $5/month; toll-free texting number $5/month; text credits $0.02 each.

limits: Free People module has unlimited contacts; paid modules limited by usage (donations/month, team members, check-ins/day, group members, rooms)
Text credits cost $0.02 each
Music Stand add-on is $5/month extra
Official pricing page shows no static per-tier amounts (calculator only)
keyFeatures: Modular a-la-carte pricing — only pay for modules you use
SOC 2 Type 2 and PCI Level 1 certified
Church Center free member-facing app and web platform included
No contracts, cancel anytime
enrichment.provenance: Pricing page fetched directly (calculator, no static amounts). SOC 2 Type 2 explicitly stated at planningcenter.com/security and confirmed via the company's SOC 2 compliance blog post. Lowest Services tier left null because the official page publishes no fixed price and aggregators conflict ($14 vs $15).

vendors.name: Tithe.ly
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from get.tithe.ly/pricing. Free Giving $0, Church Management $72, All Access $119 (reg. $228), Enterprise quote-only — all confirmed. Custom Church App $89/month and Custom Church Website $19/month also confirmed on the page. PCI DSS Level 1 and GDPR compliance confirmed in the Tithely Information Security Guide; SOC 2 not claimed.

plans.name: Free Giving
plans.notes: No monthly fee. Unlimited donations, iOS/Android app, pledge campaigns, recurring giving, tax statements, QuickBooks integration. Processing fees: 2.9% + $0.30 (credit/debit), 1% + $0.30 (ACH), 3.5% + $0.30 (AMEX).

plans.name: Church Management + Giving
plans.notes: Everything in Free Giving plus unlimited admin users, volunteer coordination, admin mobile app, drag-and-drop email editor, member engagement via text (ChMS). Confirmed $72/month on official page.

plans.name: All Access
plans.notes: All products in one plan: giving, church management, custom church app, church website, and worship planning tools. Listed as regularly $228/month value. Confirmed $119/month on official page.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: For larger churches; negotiated rates and dedicated support. Contact sales for quote. No published price.

limits: Free plan limited to giving only, no ChMS features
Custom Church App sold separately at $89/month or included in All Access
Custom Church Website $19/month standalone or included in All Access
keyFeatures: Free online giving with no monthly subscription
All-in-one bundle at $119/month (giving + ChMS + app + website + worship tools)
Breeze ChMS owned by Tithe.ly, sold separately or as bundle
PCI DSS Level 1 and GDPR compliant
enrichment.provenance: Pricing fetched directly from get.tithe.ly/pricing; all plan prices confirmed. PCI DSS Level 1 and GDPR compliance explicitly stated in the Tithely Information Security Guide; SOC 2 is NOT claimed so soc2 stays null.

vendors.name: Breeze ChMS
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched directly from breezechms.com/pricing confirming $72/month flat rate, $29/month Worship Tools add-on, 30-day free trial, 250 free texts/month then $10 per 500. No SOC2 or HIPAA claims found. Breeze is owned by Tithe.ly.

plans.name: Breeze ChMS
plans.notes: Single flat-rate plan, no tiers by church size. Unlimited admin users and people, volunteer tracking, service planning, calendar, groups, email, admin mobile app, automation. 250 free texts/month then $10 per 500. Free giving included. No setup fees, no contract. Confirmed $72/month.

plans.name: Breeze + Worship Tools Add-on
plans.notes: Breeze ChMS ($72) plus Worship Tools add-on ($29/month) = $101/month. Worship tools includes chord charts, service planning, and worship team features. Add-on price confirmed on official page.

limits: 250 SMS texts free per month, then $10 per 500
No tiered limits on contacts or admins
Worship tools require $29/month add-on
keyFeatures: Single flat-rate pricing regardless of church size or contact count
30-day free trial, no credit card required
Built-in free online giving (powered by Tithe.ly)
Owned by Tithe.ly — tight integration with Tithely ecosystem
enrichment.provenance: Pricing page fetched directly; $72/month flat rate, $29 Worship Tools add-on, and 30-day trial all confirmed. Security page shows no SOC2/HIPAA — only PCI/SSL and AWS hosting; compliance fields kept null.

vendors.name: ChurchTrac
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from churchtrac.com/pricing and homepage. ChurchTrac has a genuine FREE-FOREVER plan (unlimited names, basic people management) distinct from the 30-day trial — corrected from the draft (was freeTier:false). Paid plans start at $9/month (scaling by database size); accounting add-on $15/month, messaging add-on $7/month (250 SMS) — all confirmed on the official homepage and pricing page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever. Add as many names as needed; manage people and families, user accounts, free imports/backups, print reports and directories, send email/SMS/phone messages, tech support. Excludes attendance tracking, check-in, donation reporting, accounting (paid features).

plans.name: All-In-One (Base)
plans.notes: Paid plans start at $9/month, priced by number of tracked people (scales for larger databases). Includes people management, email/push notifications, website, church app, giving, check-in, attendance, groups, registrations, volunteer scheduling, worship planning, automations. 10% discount with annual billing.

plans.name: Accounting Add-on
plans.notes: Optional fund accounting, bank syncing, budgeting, financial statements. '+$15/month more' on the official homepage. Available at any database tier.

plans.name: Messaging Add-on
plans.notes: Enhanced messaging: includes 250 SMS credits/month; additional 250-credit blocks $7 each. Available at any database tier.

limits: Database-size pricing for paid plans (e.g. 75, 125, 250, 500, 1000, unlimited names)
Free plan excludes attendance, check-in, donation reporting, accounting
Accounting and messaging are paid add-ons
250 SMS included in $7/month messaging add-on
keyFeatures: Genuine free-forever plan for basic people management
Usage-based paid pricing scales with church size
All-in-one platform replacing multiple tools
10% annual billing discount; 30-day free trial of paid features
bestFor: churches wanting one tool for everything
enrichment.provenance: Pricing page and homepage fetched directly. Free-forever plan confirmed via churchtrac.com (distinct from the 30-day trial) — draft's freeTier:false corrected to true and a Free plan added. Paid base $9/month, accounting +$15/month, messaging +$7/month confirmed on the official homepage.

vendors.name: Subsplash
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from subsplash.com/pricing. Subsplash Giving confirmed $0/month (2.3% + 30c cards, 1% ACH; as low as 1.9% + 30c / 0.5% ACH with GrowCurve). Subsplash One and Enterprise are quote-only with no published price.

plans.name: Subsplash Giving
plans.notes: No monthly fee. Mobile, web, and text giving; donor management; recurring gifts; check scanning; real-time analytics. Processing: 2.3% + $0.30 (cards), 1% (ACH); as low as 1.9% + $0.30 / 0.5% ACH with GrowCurve volume program. Confirmed $0 on official page.

plans.name: Subsplash One
plans.notes: Custom pricing based on church size and usage. Includes websites, media hosting, custom apps, live streaming, online giving, people management, event registration, group messaging, volunteer management, child check-in, service planning, email/SMS, podcasting. Contact sales for quote. No published price.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: All Subsplash One features plus custom API integrations, multi-campus app, and Rock RMS integration. Requires sales contact. No published price.

limits: Subsplash One and Enterprise pricing not public — requires sales call
GrowCurve volume discounts on transaction fees require negotiation
Multi-campus and custom API only in Enterprise tier
keyFeatures: Free giving platform with competitive transaction rates
Comprehensive church app, media, and streaming platform
GrowCurve program reduces transaction fees at volume
Rock RMS native plugin for enterprise ChMS integration
enrichment.provenance: Pricing page fetched directly; only Giving plan has a published price ($0), confirmed along with 2.3%+30c card / GrowCurve rates. Subsplash One and Enterprise require sales contact and have no public prices (null).

vendors.name: Servant Keeper
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched directly from servantkeeper.com/pricing and corroborated via Capterra. Core $79.99/mo ($73.32/mo annual) and Complete $159.99/mo ($146.66/mo annual) confirmed exactly. Check-in $199 add-on on Core, included in Complete. No public compliance certifications.

plans.name: Core (Monthly)
plans.notes: Unlimited families and members, ~4 estimated users, full apps and reporting, standard payment processing rate. Check-in module optional at $199 add-on. Standard phone/email/chat support. Self-guided onboarding. Confirmed $79.99/month.

plans.name: Core (Annual)
plans.notes: Billed as $879.89/year (monthly-equivalent $73.32). Same features as Core Monthly. Saves ~$80/year vs monthly. ~8% annual discount.

plans.name: Complete (Monthly)
plans.notes: Unlimited families and members, ~8 estimated users, full apps and reporting, preferred payment processing rate, check-in included, premium support, kick-off call onboarding, white glove data transfer, unlimited email (SK Connect), 1,000 SMS/month, website and app, 50GB content library, 25 hours/month 720p HD livestreaming. 'Best value'. Confirmed $159.99/month.

plans.name: Complete (Annual)
plans.notes: Billed as $1,759.89/year (monthly-equivalent $146.66). Same features as Complete Monthly. Saves ~$160/year vs monthly. ~8% annual discount.

limits: Core plan limited to ~4 users; Complete limited to ~8 users
Check-in module is $199 add-on on Core plan, included in Complete
1,000 SMS/month cap on Complete; overage pricing not stated
keyFeatures: Transparent two-plan pricing with monthly and annual options
Complete plan includes website, app, and 720p HD livestreaming
White-glove data migration included in Complete
QuickBooks automated integration (Desktop and Online)
bestFor: churches wanting bundled website and livestream
ministries migrating from legacy desktop software
enrichment.provenance: Pricing page fetched directly and corroborated via Capterra; Core $79.99/$73.32 and Complete $159.99/$146.66 confirmed exactly. No public compliance certifications found — compliance fields null.

vendors.name: Realm by ACS Technologies
vendors.provenance: Plans page fetched from acstechnologies.com/realm/plans (three tiers, no public price for Connect/Multiply). Realm Inform $49/month confirmed directly at buy.acst.com/realm-inform ('after the 30-day free trial, billed at $49/month, no contract'). Connect and Multiply are quote-only.

plans.name: Realm Inform
plans.notes: Staff-only plan. Month-to-month, no contract. Data management, congregation insights, reporting, contribution acceptance. 30-day free trial then $49/month. Accounting add-on available separately. Confirmed $49/month at the direct purchase page.

plans.name: Realm Connect
plans.notes: Built for the entire congregation including member-facing features. Pricing based on typical weekly attendance. Quote required (contact 1-800-736-7425). No published price. Billing model set to custom (attendance-based, not a fixed per-seat rate).

plans.name: Realm Multiply
plans.notes: For multi-site churches. Everything in Inform and Connect plus multi-campus administration and outreach. Quote required. No published price.

limits: Inform plan is staff-only — no member-facing portal
Connect and Multiply pricing not published — requires sales contact
Accounting is a paid add-on on all plans
keyFeatures: 30-day free trial on Inform plan
Three-tier architecture from staff-only to multi-campus
Long-established ACS Technologies platform
Background check integrations and outreach features in upper tiers
bestFor: churches already on ACS legacy platform
enrichment.provenance: Plans page shows three tiers, no public prices for Connect/Multiply. Inform $49/month confirmed at buy.acst.com/realm-inform. Connect billing model corrected from per_seat to custom (attendance-based quote).
